native_timing_samples.selection: GPU3: original last 20 completed records at fixed cutoff. GPU6: two already-read recent records retained plus 18 latest other completed records at fixed cutoff; not a random sample.
native_timing_samples.pairing: Within each isolated claim, completed native calls in completion-file timestamp order paired with successful generation turns in original ordinal order. Terminal no-generation budget boundary excluded; no new numerical call executed.

timing_semantics.turn_wall: finished_monotonic - started_monotonic from completed owner turn. Queue wait is separate.
timing_semantics.native_seconds: Original CalibrationActor.generate_native elapsed value; includes its input preparation/logging, CUDA generation and sampling-trace work up to elapsed capture. It is not a pure GPU-kernel profiler measurement.
timing_semantics.outside_native: Turn wall minus native seconds includes exact-request preparation, codec/ledger/logging, synchronization/RNG guards and other surrounding work; no per-component profiler attribution was performed.
timing_semantics.cross_GPU_comparison: GPU3 and GPU6 samples use different tasks, contexts and output lengths. Their absolute times cannot measure relative card speed.

host_and_scorer_prior_snapshot.restriction: Normal scoring summary excludes technical-unknown outcomes and does not characterize the timeout tail.

separate_scoring_timeout.interpretation: Official test timeout remains technical unknown. A zero wrapper exit code does not make it a resolved/unresolved model result.

kernel_fallback.dispatch: Private installed decorator chooses reference torch_function when importing causal_conv1d/fla fails; both resident startup logs explicitly show that choice. CUDA tensors remain on GPU.

reference_implementations.causal_conv1d_fn: PyTorch grouped F.conv1d for sequence input.
reference_implementations.causal_conv1d_update: Concatenate/update convolution state then grouped F.conv1d for cached decoding.
reference_implementations.chunk_gated_delta_rule: FP32 tensor operations and sequential chunk scan for prefill/multi-token branch.
reference_implementations.fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule: FP32 tensor operations and token recurrence for single-token cached decoding.

recovery_status.source: Parent-agent rollout report in this thread; not re-probed during archival. Earlier 19:05:24 CST queue snapshot independently showed five active generation episodes.

ETA.statement: Conservative planning interval: 2–4 days after pipeline recovery. This is conditional extrapolation, not a confidence interval or guarantee.

Different tasks and outputs; no paired serial-versus-interleaved causal estimate.
Future CPU-heavy tests, long contexts and shared GPU contention may change rates.
